get.summary: That the API answers. Anybody may ask.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Asks for a password reset to be sent to an email address. Anybody may ask; the answer is the same whether or not a person has that address.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Sets a new password with the code a reset message carried. The code is good once.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Signs a back-office or outside user in with their email address and password, and their authenticator code where they have one. The tokens are set as cookies; the answer holds none.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Gives a session a new access token and a new refresh token. A refresh token is good once: one presented a second time ends its session.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Ends the session on the server and clears its cookies.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.
A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

get.summary: The CSRF value of the session the refresh token belongs to, for a page that was loaded anew.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: The signed-in person sets a new password, giving their current one. Their other sessions end.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Begins setting up the signed-in person’s authenticator: answers the secret for the app. Nothing is kept until a code proves it.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Finishes setting up the signed-in person’s authenticator with a code from it. Their other sessions end.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: An admin clears another person’s authenticator. Their sessions end; it is a security event.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: An admin creates an admin, a manager/analyst or a read-only viewer (a client user, a contractor user with its contractor, or an auditor). Never a monitor. The person has no password until an admin sets one.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

get.summary: One person, as an admin or a manager/analyst reads them. A monitor’s phone number is in an admin’s answer only.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

put.summary: An admin states the permissions a manager/analyst holds from now on. One taken away refuses that person’s very next request.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

put.summary: An admin states the projects a read-only viewer sees from now on. One not named is taken away.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: An admin sets a person’s password. Their sessions end, and they set one of their own at their next sign-in.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: An admin ends every session a person has open.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: An admin archives a person. Their sessions end and they are refused at once. The only admin can’t be archived.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

get.summary: The firm’s clients whose name holds what was typed; none archived.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Creates a client: the jurisdiction or agency paying for the work.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

get.summary: The declaration events whose name or reference holds what was typed; none archived.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Creates a declaration event: the disaster and its reference as written, its reference type picked from the firm’s list.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Creates a project under a client and a declaration event, with its time zone, active window, ticket-number source, ticket types and kinds of unit rate work.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

patch.summary: Changes a project’s own settings; one left out stays as it is. Its tickets not locked as invoiced are queued.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

patch.summary: Changes a project’s active window: either end; the end may be emptied. Its tickets not locked as invoiced are queued.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Closes a project: the mark and its time. Nothing under it is deleted or refused after.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Starts a number series the project doesn’t have yet (its cert numbers), from the number the firm says.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Enters a run of pre-printed control tickets on a project that numbers its tickets from them.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Takes off a control range entered by mistake. It is archived, never deleted.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Adds a field tag at the end of the project’s own list.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

get.summary: The firm’s contractors whose name holds what was typed; none archived.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Creates a contractor record, firm-wide. Whoever adds it says its kind.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Adds a contractor to a project as a prime.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Creates a contract on a project: its name, one of the project’s primes, and an optional link to the signed copy.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Adds a debris type to the firm’s library, named as its contracts name the work.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Adds a payable type to the firm’s list: the work a pay item prices.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.
